title: First Steps
subtitle: Five quests, no tricks
description: A chain, so each quest unlocks when the one before it is done, and the canvas
draws it left to right because these five name their dependencies.
Two quests here count what you are carrying and finish by themselves; one is a
button you press on purpose; one asks for a stack of something; and one is a
place rather than a task list. That is the whole vocabulary, and every other
chapter in this collection is a longer sentence written with it.
